package demo;
import javax.baja.sys.*;
public final class C21 extends BComponent {
  private Clock.Ticket a;
  private Clock.Ticket b;
  public void arm() { a = Clock.schedule(this, BRelTime.makeSeconds(5), x, null); b = Clock.schedule(this, BRelTime.makeSeconds(9), y, null); }
  public void stopped() throws Exception { super.stopped(); other.cancelTicket(a); this.cancelTicket(b); }
  private void cancelTicket(Clock.Ticket t) { if (t != null) t.cancel(); }
}
